extracted.intended_audience: BBC journalists, editors, producers and other BBC content creators/contributors
extracted.subtask_description: The BBC's official Editorial Guidelines (2025) setting the organisation's editorial values, standards and topic-specific rules that apply to all BBC content worldwide. The page lists the guideline sections (e.g., Impartiality, Accuracy, Privacy) and points to updated guidance and training modules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Guidelines 2025
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editorial Guidelines set the BBC's editorial values and standards. The guidelines apply to all BBC content wherever in the world it is broadcast or published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All guidance has been updated and came into effect from Monday 1 September 2025. The Academy has designed a series of online modules to help you understand changes to the Editorial Guidelines; courses accessible on Gateway. Page lists the guideline sections below.
